data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for reCAPTCHA Enterprise security protection.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise into Flutter applications for iOS and Android. It allows fetching a client via site keys and executing actions like login or registration to obtain a verification token.
use_when: You need to protect your mobile app actions against bots and fraudulent traffic using reCAPTCHA Enterprise.
You are building an app for Android and iOS that requires security token verification on user actions.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
You do not use Google Cloud reCAPTCHA Enterprise backend services.
strengths: Official plugin supporting reCAPTCHA Enterprise for Flutter.
Simple client initialization and action execution flow.
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS platforms.
Requires platform-specific site keys and configuration setup.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining reCAPTCHA Enterprise site keys for both Android and iOS from the Google Cloud Console, and setting them up in native app configurations.
